disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了宿主侧与浏览器侧全部源码的凭据读写面：未发现读取凭据文件、私钥、云厂商密钥等敏感路径的代码，也未发现硬编码的密钥或令牌。
checked_items.en: Checked the credential read/write surface of all source code on both host side and browser side: no code was found that reads credential files, private keys, cloud vendor secrets, or other sensitive paths, and no hardcoded keys or tokens were found.

checked_items.zh: 用户可选的 GitHub Token 仅保存在浏览器本地存储（代码注释明确说明），只作为请求头随 GitHub 搜索请求发出，未发现将其转发给任何第三方的路径。
checked_items.en: The user-optional GitHub Token is only stored in browser local storage (as explicitly noted in code comments) and is only sent as a request header with GitHub search requests; no path was found that forwards it to any third party.

checked_items.zh: 核查了可选统计服务的上报内容：仅包含仓库名、事件类型与随机匿名 ID，不含任何凭据或用户身份信息。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the reported content of the optional statistics service: it only contains the repository name, event type, and a random anonymous ID, with no credentials or user identity information.

evidence.zh: 插件未读取任何凭据文件或敏感路径，无凭据外泄的读取面，因此该场景不适用；用户 Token 仅存本地浏览器并仅发往 GitHub 官方接口。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read any credential files or sensitive paths, and has no read surface for credential exfiltration, so this scenario is not applicable; the user Token is only stored locally in the browser and only sent to GitHub's official API.

checked_items.zh: 确认本插件不注册任何面向模型的工具，也不调用系统提示注入接口——不存在工具描述投毒面；模型上下文不会出现本插件注入的文本。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that this plugin does not register any model-facing tools and does not call system prompt injection interfaces—there is no tool description poisoning surface; no text injected by this plugin appears in the model context.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部用户可见文本（README、界面文案、错误提示、工具文本）：未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、上下文优先级操纵等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked all user-visible texts (README, UI copy, error messages, tool texts): no injection wording such as instruction overrides, system message impersonation, or context priority manipulation was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库内是否存在模型面指令文件（如技能说明、代理指令）：未发现此类文件，也未发现远程指令加载类文案。
checked_items.en: Checked the repository for model-facing instruction files (e.g., skill descriptions, agent instructions): no such files were found, and no remote instruction loading copy was found either.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何模型工具、不注入系统提示，工具描述投毒面不存在，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any model tools or inject system prompts; the tool description poisoning surface does not exist, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件不面向模型输出文本，安装/卸载均由用户在浏览器界面点击发起，不存在提示注入驱动安装的入口，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not output text to the model, and installation/uninstallation are both initiated by user clicks in the browser UI; there is no prompt-injection-driven installation entry, so this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中的系统命令调用（规则 X03/DG-R3-55，位于宿主入口源码）经核查用于插件声明的安装/更新/卸载功能：执行 git 克隆、拉取与 dsh 插件管理命令；仓库参数经格式校验、克隆地址限定 GitHub 域名，且接口要求自定义请求头，未发现脱离该业务路径的执行面。
checked_items.en: The system command invocation hit by static scanning (rule X03/DG-R3-55, located in the host entry source code) was verified to be used for the plugin's declared install/update/uninstall functionality: it executes git clone, git pull, and dsh plugin management commands; repository parameters are format-validated, clone URLs are restricted to the GitHub domain, and the API requires custom request headers; no execution surface outside this business path was found.

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中的浏览器剪贴板写入（规则 X05/DG-R3-57，构建产物与源码各一处）是用户点击「复制」按钮复制安装命令的交互，无自动读取、无凭据接触。
checked_items.en: The browser clipboard write hit by static scanning (rule X05/DG-R3-57, one in build artifacts and one in source code) is the interaction where the user clicks the "Copy" button to copy the install command; there is no automatic read and no contact with credentials.

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中的超长行与转义密度信号（规则 X08/DG-R3-60，构建产物与源码各两处）分别为一段内联 CSS 样式表和一个侧栏图标的表情符号转义，属正常 UI 代码，无混淆、无动态解码执行。
checked_items.en: The overlong-line and escape-density signals hit by static scanning (rule X08/DG-R3-60, two in build artifacts and two in source code) are respectively an inline CSS stylesheet and emoji escapes in a sidebar icon; they are normal UI code, with no obfuscation and no dynamic decoding execution.

checked_items.zh: 检查了补丁文件、运行时求值与安装钩子：补丁文件无可执行脚本标量，运行时代码无动态求值调用，包声明无安装前后钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch file, runtime evaluation, and install hooks: the patch file has no executable script scalars, the runtime code has no dynamic evaluation calls, and the package declaration has no pre/post-install or prepare hooks.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件只含一行插件激活插入，无任何可执行脚本标量，patch 即执行的场景不适用。
evidence.en: The patch file contains only a single line for plugin activation insertion, with no executable script scalars; the patch-is-executed scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用宿主动态包执行工具，无自修改执行面，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call host dynamic package execution tools and has no self-modifying execution surface, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 本包未声明安装前后或准备钩子；包内无钩子管理器、CI 工作流、容器配置等树内执行载体；构建脚本仅为把浏览器端源码包装为客户端模块的本地构建。
evidence.en: This package does not declare pre/post-install or prepare hooks; there are no in-tree execution carriers such as hook managers, CI workflows, or container configurations; the build script is only a local build that wraps browser-side source code into a client module.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端模块；其客户端代码无键盘监听、无剪贴板读取、无凭据特权调用，唯一剪贴板写入是用户点击复制安装命令的按钮交互。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side module; its client code has no keyboard listeners, no clipboard reads, and no privileged credential calls; the only clipboard write is the button interaction where the user clicks to copy the install command.

checked_items.zh: 盘点全部网络外联面：浏览器侧连接 GitHub 搜索接口、raw 内容分发域名（插件特征验证与 README 获取）、Google 翻译接口；宿主侧仅当配置了统计服务地址环境变量时才上报匿名安装事件（默认关闭）。均为文档声明的功能。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound network surfaces: the browser side connects to the GitHub search API, the raw content distribution domain (for plugin feature verification and README retrieval), and the Google Translate API; the host side only reports anonymous install events when a statistics service address environment variable is configured (disabled by default). All are declared features in the documentation.

checked_items.zh: 未发现凭据读取配合外联的组合链路、编码后外发链或带外通道；未发现对未声明域名的请求，也没有命令行外发工具调用。
checked_items.en: No combined chain of credential reading with outbound connections, encoded exfiltration chain, or out-of-band channel was found; no requests to undeclared domains were found, and no command-line exfiltration tool calls were seen.

checked_items.zh: 核查了可选统计服务的实现：上报内容为仓库名、事件类型、随机匿名 ID，无 IP、路径或用户身份持久化，失败时静默降级。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the implementation of the optional statistics service: the reported content is the repository name, event type, and a random anonymous ID, with no IP, path, or user identity persistence, and it silently degrades on failure.

evidence.zh: 插件无凭据文件读取面，也没有把本地数据编码外发的通道；网络连接均指向功能所需的公开接口，凭据外泄场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin has no credential file read surface and no channel for encoding local data for exfiltration; all network connections point to public interfaces required by functionality, so the credential exfiltration scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 包声明无安装钩子，且无任何第三方运行时依赖，不存在依赖投毒、依赖混淆或浮动版本引用面。
checked_items.en: The package declares no install hooks and has no third-party runtime dependencies, so there is no supply chain poisoning, dependency confusion, or floating version reference surface.

checked_items.zh: 补丁文件仅插入激活行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用安全项的写法，无环境变量降权写法，也未改写注入/拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch file only inserts an activation line and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permission settings; there is no way to disable security items, no environment variable privilege-lowering pattern, and no rewriting of injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 插件未对安全事件做高优先级监听，无截断审批链的行为；作者为真实 GitHub 账号，许可证为 MIT。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not listen at high priority to security events and has no behavior that truncates the approval chain; the author is a real GitHub account and the license is MIT.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法做升级自动激活与版本突变比对，相关结论以本快照静态分析为准。
checked_items.en: This is the first audit with no baseline from a previous version, so upgrade auto-activation and version-mutation comparison cannot be performed; related conclusions are based on static analysis of this snapshot.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件只有激活插入行，未覆盖任何安全配置行，也未出现禁用项或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch file only contains an activation insertion line, does not override any security configuration lines, and shows no disabled items or privilege-lowering patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何审批、执行前等安全事件的监听器，无审批链截断面，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register listeners for security events such as approval or pre-execution, and has no approval-chain truncation surface, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线可比较，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no version baseline to compare, so the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未改写注入或拦截配置，无给安全插件追加必需服务导致其挂起的攻击面。
evidence.en: The patch file does not rewrite injection or interception configuration, and has no attack surface where required services are appended to security plugins to hang them.

checked_items.zh: 插件在宿主 web 服务上注册了安装管理接口（状态/预检/安装/更新/卸载），均要求自定义请求头并通过参数格式校验；宿主 webserver 本身无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件特有，且本插件在能力范围内做了防护。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers install management APIs on the host web service (status/preflight/install/update/uninstall), all requiring custom request headers and passing parameter format validation; the host webserver itself lacking authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk, not specific to this plugin, and this plugin has applied defenses within its capability.

checked_items.zh: 卸载流程在 Windows 下会调度宿主进程重启（生成临时批处理脚本杀掉旧进程并按原参数重启），属插件声明的「卸载后自动重启刷新插件表」功能，由用户在界面点击触发；桌面端不自动自杀。
checked_items.en: On Windows, the uninstall flow schedules a host process restart (generating a temporary batch script that kills the old process and restarts it with the original parameters); this is the plugin's declared "auto-restart after uninstall to refresh plugin table" feature, triggered by user clicks in the UI; the desktop side does not self-terminate automatically.

checked_items.zh: 宿主启动时向一个硬编码的绝对路径写时间戳探针文件（调试遗留，写失败静默忽略），未涉及敏感数据，仅作记录。
checked_items.en: At host startup, a timestamp probe file is written to a hardcoded absolute path (a debugging leftover, silently ignored on write failure); it involves no sensitive data and is only recorded.

checked_items.zh: 未启用动态沙箱验证（L4），运行时行为以静态分析为准。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification is not enabled (L4); runtime behavior is based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动监听服务，仅复用宿主 web 服务注册带自定义请求头防护的路由；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主固有风险，插件已做请求头与参数双重校验。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own listening service; it only reuses the host web service to register routes protected by custom request headers; unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent host risk, and the plugin has applied both request header and parameter validation.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：插件声明合法、补丁文件存在、无仿冒名迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the plugin declaration is legitimate, the patch file exists, and there are no signs of name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：7 条机械命中逐条核查均为良性用法，无补丁执行标量、无动态求值、无硬编码凭据。
summary.en: Static scanning completed: all 7 mechanical hits were individually verified as benign usage, with no patch execution scalars, no dynamic evaluation, and no hardcoded credentials.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取，外联域名均为功能所需。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, and all outbound domains are functionally required.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：插件不注册模型工具，无提示词注入措辞，无诱导安装或诱导改配置文案。
summary.en: AI metadata review: the plugin does not register model tools, has no prompt injection wording, and has no copy inducing installation or configuration changes.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed at this stage (no sandbox artifacts).

limits.zh: L4 动态沙箱未启用（无沙箱产物），运行时行为未做动态验证；插件清单未显式声明能力，能力字段按代码实测推断；浏览器端构建产物与源码同源（由构建脚本生成），按同源代码核查；宿主启动时写入硬编码绝对路径的时间戳探针为调试遗留，未作为漏洞收录。
limits.en: L4 dynamic sandbox not enabled (no sandbox artifacts), runtime behavior not dynamically verified; the plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capabilities, so capability fields are inferred from code inspection; browser-side build artifacts and source code are same-origin (generated by the build script) and reviewed as same-source code; the timestamp probe written to a hardcoded absolute path at host startup is a debugging leftover and is not recorded as a vulnerability.
